name: Granada (Spain)
description: Vertically divided crimson and green, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Granada (the Catholic Monarchs, the Torre de la Vela and a pomegranate).
history: The symbols of the municipality of Granada were made official by the resolution of 10 February 2009 of the Dirección General de Administración Local admitting the arms and flag to the Registro Andaluz de Entidades Locales (BOJA no. 36 of 23 February 2009); the flag carries the arms of the city embroidered at the centre.
